tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/password-hashing.md <<'EOF'
# Password hashing

The project's current recorded decision is to hash passwords with argon2id. This was the most recent statement on the subject in the project's recorded history, and no later decision has changed it.
EOF
cat docs/policies/password-hashing.md
tool_input.description: Create the password hashing policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It says the current recorded decision is argon2id.

Muninn has no formal decision record for password hashing. The catalog doesn't list one. The only record is in session transcripts, where you first said bcrypt and later said argon2id. The argon2id statement is the newer one, so I treated it as the latest word. I left bcrypt out of the file, as you asked. If you want this settled as a formal decision, tell me and I'll adjust the file.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error. I wrote it with the Write tool instead.

Muninn also reported a red heartbeat at session start: 20 hook runs started and never finished. That points to a hook exceeding its timeout, and `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` should show which one. It doesn't affect this file, but it may mean some memory records are missing.
